(Japanese: '''アキラ''' ''Akira'') is a middle-school student in the manga series [[How I Became a Pokémon Card]]. He is an aspiring [[Pokémon Master]], but his only Pokémon is a {{p|Scyther}} he received as a present for finishing sixth grade. His best friend is {{HIBAPC|Akari}}.
